data_objects.name: tree_inventory_records
data_objects.meaning: Plot-based inventory records for individual trees, including species, dimensions, basal area, and plot expansion information.
data_objects.notes: Identifier and measurement expansions follow the explicit field labels; the CON code is not defined in the table.

variables.name: LIVE_ID
variables.meaning: Identifier for the individual live-tree record.

variables.name: PLTID
variables.meaning: Identifier of the inventory plot containing the tree.

variables.name: SPP_SYMBOL
variables.meaning: Abbreviated species symbol associated with the tree.

variables.name: SCIENTIFIC_NAME
variables.meaning: Scientific taxon name corresponding to the species symbol.

variables.name: CON
variables.meaning: Numeric condition or category code labeled CON.

variables.name: BA_M2
variables.meaning: Basal area associated with the tree record.

variables.name: TPH_PLT
variables.meaning: Plot-level trees-per-hectare expansion value associated with the tree.

structure.description: Each row is an individual tree inventory record; LIVE_ID serves as the row identifier and PLTID groups trees within plots.
SPP_SYMBOL and SCIENTIFIC_NAME are paired species encodings for the same tree.

uncertainties: The meaning and codebook for CON are not supplied.
The table does not state the inventory date, location, or sampling protocol.
annotation_notes: Meanings and units are limited to information conveyed by the source fields and train.csv values.
